name: mirage
text: Yes, with one exception. The engine copies every setting from the Bids tab (minimum edge, kinds, books agreeing, Kelly, limits, windows) each time you change one, and its bid desk is the same code as the phone's, so those rules apply. The exception is the two bid switches that override the usual rules. With 'More, smaller bids' (or the volume mode) on, the edge floor is set by the bid tier instead of your minimum-edge number: 1.5% for proven bet types and 2.5% for riskier ones. It also drops the start-time limit, and the 'sharp book required' rule drops except on risky bids. Your dollar limits are not touched. With both off, your Bids tab numbers apply exactly. So if your minimum edge is above 1.5% and 'More, smaller bids' is on, the engine is posting at 1.5%. Do you want the tier floors to respect your minimum edge as a floor, or keep them as they are for volume?
